comments.author: @tishguerrero
comments.text: I had friends who were tour guides at the Winchester house. They spoke of odd things that happened late evenings. They would have to go around the house at closing time and close doors and windows when tourist left. Smell of home made chicken soup lingered in the kitchen. Which was Sarah’s favorite. Other  incidents, doors would slammed, and someone brush pass by them. Lights flickered, etc.
